title: Amply regular graphs with $μ$ close to half the valency and group divisible designs
summary: In this paper, we classify connected amply regular graphs with diameter $d \geq 4$ and parameters $(v, k, λ, μ)$ satisfying $μ= \frac{k-1}{2}$, where $k\geq 5$ is odd. We prove that such a graph must be exactly one of the following: the $5$-cube, the graph $\K_2 \square Λ$, where $Λ$ is the unique bipartite $(0,2)$-graph on $14$ vertices, or the point--block incidence graph of a group divisible design with the dual property, namely a $GDDDP\left(2, k+1;\, k;\, 0, \frac{k-1}{2}\right)$.
